clashgram.description:
Clashgram Web is a privacy-hardened, high-performance web and native client for Telegram. Built as an advanced fork of the official Telegram Web application, Clashgram introduces zero-telemetry stealth features, persistent client-side message retention, hardware-accelerated glassmorphism design presets, and fully offline, on-device Whisper AI audio transcription.
